records.title: SIAM IIT MENTORSHIP PROGRAM
records.summary: A chapter-run mentorship network connecting newer students with upperclassmen and alumni for guidance on academics, research, professional development, and finding their place at Illinois Tech.
records.history: The program was created around the idea that students should not be expected to arrive knowing how to navigate college, mathematics, research, or professional opportunities on their own. It aimed to build continuity across generations of Illinois Tech students by connecting alumni with current students and older students with newer students.

participants.mentees: Primarily first-year, second-year, and transfer students in applied mathematics, statistics, and data science.
participants.mentors: Primarily third-year and more advanced Applied Mathematics students, with alumni also participating in the broader network.

activities: Building connections with faculty and the Chicago applied mathematics community

records.title: CHICAGO AREA SIAM STUDENT CONFERENCE
records.summary: A two-day regional gathering bringing students and researchers together for national-laboratory visits, talks, scientific discussion, new connections, and a little bowling and symphony along the way.
records.history: The 2024 Chicago Area SIAM Student Conference was held jointly with the SPS Zone 9 Meeting and brought together students from more than ten universities. Day 1 sent attendees to Fermilab and Argonne National Laboratory before everyone reconvened for dinner and an evening at The Bog. Day 2 continued at Illinois Tech with talks and discussion spanning applied mathematics, physics, machine learning, uncertainty quantification, and scientific computing, before concluding at the Chicago Symphony Orchestra.

records.title: WELCOME WEEK
records.summary: SIAM IIT's Welcome Week programming introduced students to the chapter, research, applied mathematics, and opportunities to get involved in the wider Illinois Tech scientific community.
records.history: A surviving SIAM IIT Welcome Week page documents a planned chapter event that was ultimately cancelled and postponed because chapter executives were away conducting research and the selected representative had a family issue. The page also looks back on the previous year's Welcome Week gathering, describing roughly 80 attendees—many of them students outside mathematics—staying after a research discussion for the SIAM IIT event. Alongside its own programming, the chapter used the page as a guide to other Welcome Week opportunities, including the College of Computing Reception, Summer Research Expo, and Student Involvement Fair.
